item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Rotate uncertain diagnoses at safe checkpoints","mechanism":"A review interval prevents one uncertain repair from continuously occupying a bench while safe, bounded jobs wait.","implementation":"Set a 15-minute review timer, not a completion deadline. At safe checkpoints, park unresolved items with location recorded; alternate bounded jobs and oldest deferred diagnoses.","check":"Log bench occupancy and deferrals; flag any waiting bounded job bypassed at two safe checkpoints.","risk":"Unsafe-to-move equipment must remain secured, even if rotation pauses."},{"action":"Give parts-blocked items a separate state","mechanism":"Explicit parts holds distinguish inactive items from bench work and define what permits their return.","implementation":"Use a labelled existing storage area and matching register status. Record item ID, location, required part, sourcing responsibility, and restart condition; retain the owner receipt.","check":"At closing, verify every parts-held item matches its recorded location and has a sourcing owner; exclude holds from active-work counts.","risk":"If safe storage is unavailable, arrange receipted owner collection."},{"action":"Make custody and handoffs explicit","mechanism":"Linked, append-only item records preserve who made each decision while a current summary exposes responsibility and next action.","implementation":"Give owner and item matching IDs. Log every location or custodian change. At handoff, outgoing and incoming custodians confirm location, status, and next action.","check":"Sample three items each shift: reconcile receipts and locations, then ask incoming custodians to state their next actions.","risk":"Keep owner contact details off publicly visible labels."},{"action":"Screen intake without opening electrical items","mechanism":"Separating visitor interviews from specialist-only opening keeps general volunteers useful without crossing the electrical safety boundary.","implementation":"General volunteers record symptoms and visitor preferences without opening electrical equipment. Mark electrical or uncertain items specialist-only. Offer collection updates, not completion promises; any completion estimate includes an explicit uncertainty range.","check":"Audit opening records for specialist attribution and visitor messages for unqualified completion promises.","risk":"Screening must not be presented as diagnosis or safety clearance."}],"abstention_reason":""}
